newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares dip in quiet trade up to H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares dip in quiet trade up to H1 results.

text.p: Danish share prices closed a little lower in a becalmed market on Monday, with things seen remaining peaceful until mid-week when key 1997 interim corporate results start flooding in.
"It is very much a case of calm before the storm. We won't see much action until Wednesday when the Novo, SAS and B&O results are expected," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index lost 0.64 point to close at 185.09 in overall bourse turnover of 831 million crowns. The KFX August future fell 0.35 point to 184.35 with 292 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Novo Nordisk closed seven crowns down at 707, with SAS shedding 4.5 crowns to finish at 100.50 and B&0 unchanged at 380.
Top banks and Sophus Berendsen were the only KFX shares to make any gains, the latter ending the day 12 crowns higher at 985.
